reviews.comment: Kristian was an incredible mentor for exploring individual sense of morals. He guided us towards forming our own opinions while still maintaining a very welcoming environment for everyone's ideas. Very available for questions and great feedback. Take him if you can!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Genuinely one of my all-time favorite professors. He always takes the time to discuss anything with you from class topics to general philosophy questions, or just your life. Much love for Kristian.

Super chill class with a super understanding prof! He was really easy to get in touch with, gave feedback on assignments, and graded fairly! He, also, remained impartial on the moral issues discussed! Would definitely take him for another class!

Super chill engineering ethics TA. Barely cared about the little things like Packback posts. He did care bout the amount of effort that went into the two essays during the semester, but so did every other TA. Understands all of the concepts really well and is able to explain them simply and clearly. Lenient on due dates as long as it's communicated

Kristian is the best TA I have ever had. He is understanding and gives good feedback for all of the writing assignments. He is one of the first TAs that I have had that actually cares about the students and actually enjoys the subject he is teaching. He expained hard ethical topics well and I highly recommend him if you have the chance to take him.

I'm not one to understand ethical theories at face value, so his explanations over those topics proved really helpful. I could not have asked for a better TA and I mean that sincerely. He was always open to helping me out in the writing-intensive part of the course and provides incredible feedback.

Kristian was an amazing TA, without him I would not have understood as much of the moral theories that were expected to be taught in this class. He is clearly passionate about the topic and that truly showed when he was teaching us, it only helped us want to learn more. Really learned the most out of this class from him.

I had Kristian in an online class that he taught at the University of Montana. He was awesome! Super funny and interesting to listen to. Lots of essays, some were kinda difficult to gather your own ideas and prove that you knew what the text meant, but he was an easy grader. It wasn't hard to get an A. I would definitely take his class again!
